test_title: PYST 9: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 29 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct meaning of the idiom:

Beard the lion in his den

options.text: Confront someone boldly in their own territory

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Confront someone boldly in their own territory.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Beard the lion in his den"** means to confront someone boldly in their own area of power or comfort. (शेर के अड्डे में उसका सामना करना)
 
 
• **Example: **She decided to beard the lion in his den by directly addressing the CEO about her concerns during the meeting.
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: Tease a dangerous person** (खतरनाक व्यक्ति को चिढ़ाना): Refers to provoking someone who is potentially harmful or dangerous.
 
 
• **Example:** Teasing a dangerous person can often lead to unwanted consequences.
 
 

 
• **Option 2: Attack from behind** (पीछे से हमला करना): Refers to an underhanded or unexpected attack that is carried out from behind.
 
 
• **Example:** The thief tried to attack the guard from behind but was caught in the act.
 
 

 
• **Option 4: Pet a lion** (शेर को सहलाना): Refers to physically touching or stroking a lion, which is not related to the idiom's meaning.
 
 
• **Example:** Petting a lion is a dangerous and risky activity.
 
 

39:T8b9,
The correct answer is **Option 3**.
